int_name: W CUMBERLAND ST & N ORKNEY ST

result.summary: The image shows a narrow, alley-like street lacking dedicated pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks or marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles, and the walking path is further constrained by parked cars and construction fencing.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no dedicated, separated space for pedestrians, forcing them to walk in the path of vehicles.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A car parked on the left side blocks the narrow paved area that might otherwise be used by pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct a raised, ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Parking Restrictions
interventions.description: Implement and enforce parking restrictions to ensure the pedestrian path remains unobstructed.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by active construction, with fencing and debris completely obstructing the sidewalk and forcing pedestrians into the roadway. There is a total lack of basic crossing infrastructure like marked crosswalks or curb ramps, and a parked vehicle further restricts visibility on this narrow one-way street.

hazards.name: Construction Fencing Obstruction
hazards.description: Chain-link fencing completely blocks the sidewalk area, forcing pedestrians to walk in the vehicle travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center foreground, surrounding the new building

hazards.name: Debris and Trash
hazards.description: Significant piles of construction debris and trash create trip hazards and further narrow the available walking space.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, inside and outside the fenced area

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large pickup truck parked near the corner narrows the roadway and blocks visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Bypass
interventions.description: Implement a protected, ADA-compliant temporary walkway around the construction site to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way at the intersection.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped curb ramps to provide accessible transitions from the sidewalk to the street.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps, creating a hostile environment for those with mobility needs. Sightlines are significantly restricted by buildings positioned at the sidewalk edge, and the absence of visible traffic control devices increases the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted markings exist to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians at the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps creates a physical barrier for wheelchair users and others with limited mobility.

hazards.name: Restricted Sightlines
hazards.description: Buildings located directly at the sidewalk edge create blind corners, making it difficult for drivers and pedestrians to see each other.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right corners where buildings meet the sidewalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style painted crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct sloped curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all four corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection and potentially install curb extensions to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The image shows an urban street with a continuous sidewalk but a complete lack of dedicated pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the visible corner. The environment is characterized by wide, unmarked pavement and parked vehicles that may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
